source: 27. Which metrics should you use to evaluate retrieval, context quality, generation, attribution, and the end-to-end ZXNAME0000XZ system? [Advanced - Evaluation] Evaluate at multiple layers. For retrieval, use evidence-oriented measures such as RecallZXNAME0001XZ, PrecisionZXNAME0002XZ, MRR/nDCG where suitable, plus latency and coverage on real query types. For the assembled context, measure whether supporting evidence is present, how much irrelevant or duplicate material remains, and whether required permissions/provenance are correct. For generation, distinguish answer correctness from faithfulness to supplied evidence and from answer relevance. For attributed answers, measure citation support and citation completeness. End-to-end evaluation should also include abstention behavior, freshness, security cases, latency, cost, and task-specific business outcomes. A single aggregate score cannot tell you which module to fix. Build slice-level results for difficult categories such as multi-hop, exact identifiers, conflicting sources, stale documents, tables, and permission-filtered queries. RAGAS, ARES, and RAGChecker all reflect this multi-dimensional view. [22][23][24]
zh: 27. 您应该使用哪些指标来评估检索、上下文质量、生成、归因和端到端 ZXNAME0000XZ 系统？ [高级-评估] 多层评估。对于检索，请在合适的情况下使用面向证据的措施，例如 RecallZXNAME0001XZ、PrecisionZXNAME0002XZ、MRR/nDCG，以及实际查询类型的延迟和覆盖率。对于组装的上下文，衡量是否存在支持证据、剩余多少不相关或重复的材料，以及所需的权限/出处是否正确。对于生成，区分答案的正确性、对所提供证据的忠实度以及答案的相关性。对于归因答案，衡量引文支持度和引文完整性。端到端评估还应包括弃权行为、新鲜度、安全案例、延迟、成本和特定于任务的业务成果。单个总分无法告诉您要修复哪个模块。为困难类别（例如多跳、精确标识符、冲突源、陈旧文档、表和权限过滤查询）构建切片级结果。 RAGAS、ARES 和 RAGChecker 都反映了这种多维视图。 [22][23][24]
